reviewer: Codex visual review; not a Deaf educator or ASL expert certification
rule: Review original hand crops before model inference. Keep visibly spread or flexed non-letter poses. Exclude object grips and letter-compatible or occluded ambiguous shapes; source no_gesture is not an ASL-negative label.

hagrid_no_gesture.other_rows: excluded: ambiguous, letter-compatible, closed fingers with hidden thumb, or object grip

hagrid_resting.other_rows: excluded: letter-compatible fist/C/pointing shape, closed parallel fingers, object grip, occlusion or uncertain crop. Partial flexion is a visible proxy for incomplete handshapes; intended sign and completeness are not source-annotated.

aslyset.review: All 20 show a spread five-finger palm, outside the alphabet vocabulary. SP controls excluded because horizontal closed-finger poses can overlap alphabet handshapes.

video_transitions: 48 frames reviewed; excluded from negative training. Many already show another valid letter; other frames are blurred, occluded, or lack a hand. Intended incomplete letter cannot be inferred from handshape alone.

validation_policy.selection: Minimize unknown validation acceptances subject to supported-letter retention; break ties toward the smallest rejection ratio. Require fewer unknown validation acceptances than baseline. Test data never select the threshold.
